cat > /tmp/f.py <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, shutil
path = '/conf/config.xml'
shutil.copy(path, path + '.bak')
tree = ET.parse(path)
root = tree.getroot()

ifaces = root.find('interfaces')

opt1 = ET.SubElement(ifaces, 'opt1')
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'enable').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'if').text = 'vtnet1'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'descr').text = 'LAN_A'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'ipaddr').text = '10.50.1.1'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'subnet').text = '24'
ET.SubElement(opt1, 'ipaddrv6').text = 'none'

opt2 = ET.SubElement(ifaces, 'opt2')
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'enable').text = '1'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'if').text = 'vtnet2'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'descr').text = 'LAN_B'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'ipaddr').text = '10.50.2.1'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'subnet').text = '24'
ET.SubElement(opt2, 'ipaddrv6').text = 'none'

filt = root.find('filter')
rule = ET.SubElement(filt, 'rule')
ET.SubElement(rule, 'type').text = 'pass'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'ipprotocol').text = 'inet'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'protocol').text = 'tcp'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'descr').text = 'antrieb: allow LAN_A to LAN_B tcp/8080'
ET.SubElement(rule, 'interface').text = 'opt1'
src = ET.SubElement(rule, 'source')
ET.SubElement(src, 'network').text = 'opt1'
dst = ET.SubElement(rule, 'destination')
ET.SubElement(dst, 'network').text = 'opt2'
ET.SubElement(dst, 'port').text = '8080'

tree.write(path, xml_declaration=True, encoding='utf-8')
print('done')
PY
python3 /tmp/f.py
